title: COBRA vs. ACA Marketplace Optimizer
description: Compare full COBRA monthly cost against a Marketplace plan net of the baseline premium tax credit. Flags the 60-day enrollment window and the 400% FPL income cliff.
data_vintage: HHS 2026 FPL · baseline ACA PTC bands (400% cliff in effect 2026)
